messages:
tess_p: quick async check — overall status on the dedicated buildout? last I saw: 48 reserved nodes, 40 staged, vendor cable shipment delayed. need a short list of blockers and owners by EOD :eyes:
alex_w: cable vendor (FiberCo) updated ETA to next Tue, shipping manifest shows partial shipment. rack techs can start partial installs for the first 16 racks this week.
ravi: power upgrades in DC-east still on schedule but PDU firmware requires vendor sign-off. that sign-off is blocking burn-in scripts (we need PDU SNMP active). owner: ravi to follow up w/ pw-vendor.
jamie.s: terraform PR #437 is waiting for egress networking review — once merged we can finalize reservation assignments for the dedicated capacity pool. pinging @networking-team for review. small snippet in PR to check:
```hcl
resource "redwood_reservation" "dedicated_2026q1" {
  count = 48
  sku   = "h100-80gb"
  region = "us-east-1"
}
```
procurement-bot: purchase order PO-99871 created for 32 cable bundles (partial fill). ETA: 2026-03-25. status: partial-shipment.
tess_p: ok — owners: alex (cabling partial installs), ravi (PDU firmware sign-off), jamie (terraform + reservation finalize). can each of you confirm and call out any blockers today?
alex_w: confirmed. I'll coordinate with on-site techs to start racking 16 nodes tomorrow afternoon. need two helpers (rack+label). tagging @ops-team.
ravi: confirmed. raised ticket INC-5532 with pw-vendor for PDU firmware sign-off. vendor asked for FRU logs; I uploaded them. estimate 36-48h turnaround. if delayed, we can hot-swap to fallback PDUs but that adds manual steps to burn-in.
jamie.s: I can address PR comments by EOD but need networking approval on the egress policy (NAT gateway path). if net-team can't review, we should schedule a 15m pairing to unblock -> propose 11:30am PT.
tess_p: good plan. one more ask — finance asked whether we should accelerate the remaining 16-node purchase (to hit committed throughput) vs wait for full manifest. alex, any quick ops cost delta if we stagger vs bulk?
alex_w: staggered arrival increases ops touch + 1 tech-day per 16 nodes (~$900) and minor shipping surcharge. bulk would save ~8% on shipping. ops preference: staggered is fine if it avoids idle inventory.
procurement-bot: note: vendor discount tier at 48 units will trigger additional 4% off if order completed before end-of-month.
tess_p: ok adding decision note — if vendor can commit to ship remaining units by 2026-03-29, we push bulk and finance to approve; otherwise we go staggered. ravi/jamie, keep this thread updated and drop quick status updates when you have them. :thumbsup:
jamie.s: will ping net-team and update here after review or pairing at 11:30.
ravi: will update INC-5532 and escalate to vendor AM if >48h.
alex_w: starting racks tomorrow, will drop quick photos and rack IDs in thread when done.
tess_p: thanks — final ask: anyone able to do a quick smoke after initial 16-node rack by Fri AM? would like a quick perf sanity (latency p50/p95) and KV cache check.
ajenkins: (joining late) I can run smoke Friday morning. add me to the test-run list.
tess_p: perfect — listing owners in thread for handoff clarity: alex_w (racking/install), ravi (power & vendor), jamie.s (infra infra-as-code + reservations), ajenkins (smoke tests), procurement-bot (PO tracking). will follow up with a short milestone message tomorrow.
